claim: By one estimate, more than 100 gigawatts of onsite gas power, the rough equivalent of 100 large gas power plants, is planned for data centers across the U.S.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-13 - not yet checked by the human annotator] The article's 'estimate' links to Bloomberg Law (9 Mar 2026): BNEF counts 'about 114 gigawatts are planned for the coming years across 115 projects' of on-site gas at data centers, 'Almost 90% of those projects are located in the US'. Global Energy Monitor, via Axios ('US data centers are driving a surge in gas-fired power projects', 26 Aug 2026, republished by Human Progress): 'A whopping 189 gigawatts is planned for on-site data centers through the first half of 2026'. More than 100 GW either way; 100 large plants is the article's own equivalence.
